title: Dijkstra Priority Frontier
summary: Maintain the best known distance to each vertex and repeatedly expand the unsettled vertex with the smallest tentative distance when all edge weights are non-negative.
recognition_signals: the objective is minimum total non-negative cost
a cheaper route to an already discovered vertex may appear later
core_rules: Only a non-stale minimum-distance heap entry is safe to expand as the current best frontier.
Relax an edge only when the new route is strictly cheaper than the stored distance.
Standard Dijkstra's finalization argument requires non-negative edge weights.
structural_steps: initialize the source distance to zero
stop when the target is finalized or the heap empties

common_confusions.distinction: BFS orders by hop count and is sufficient only when edge costs are equal. Dijkstra orders by total tentative cost for non-negative weighted edges.
Dijkstra uses a heap as a priority-selection mechanism, but adds shortest-path relaxation and distance-finalization invariants.
